notFound.title: Workspace not found
notFound.description: This workspace does not exist, has been deleted, or you are not a member.

member.title: Members
member.description: Members of this workspace and their roles here. Roles decide what they can do in this workspace; folders have their own access on top.

editRoles.title: Edit workspace roles of {{name}}
editRoles.description: You can only assign roles whose permissions you hold in this workspace.

remove.title: Remove member
remove.confirm: Remove {{name}} from this workspace? Their roles here are removed too and they will no longer be able to enter.

create.title: Invite member
create.description: They will receive an email and join this workspace by following the link. People without an account can set a password to create one (requires the platform “Create users” permission). Inviting the same email again invalidates the previous link.

revoke.title: Revoke invitation
revoke.confirm: Revoke the invitation for {{email}}? The link in the email stops working immediately.

admin.title: Workspaces
admin.description: All workspaces on the platform. You can see names, member counts and admins, but not the content inside.
admin.slugHint: Shown in the URL (/w/slug) and cannot be changed later; generated from the name when left empty.

assignAdmin.title: Assign an admin for {{name}}
assignAdmin.description: The person joins this workspace with the Workspace admin role. This is recorded in the audit log.

remove.title: Delete workspace
remove.confirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Members lose access immediately. Data is kept but cannot be restored from the UI in this version.

error.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; no leading or trailing hyphen
